The '''Cuvacia system''' was located in the [[Southern Core]] portion of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was the origin point of the [[Cuvacian ambassador]].<ref name="Galladinium">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Cuvacian ambassador]]|system=Cuvacia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Cuvacia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square K-13.<ref name="TEA" />
